answer: Each agent posts a stake bond before its vote or task counts, and the bond sits in escrow. If one operator runs two identities that claim the same work, whoever proves the overlap takes the bond. Fresh keys are cheap, but bonds are not, so a Sybil swarm must lock real capital for every fake node. A single whisper of doubt opens a challenge window, and the bond stays anchored until it closes. Honest agents lose nothing. Cheats forfeit their sable collateral.
